description: Implementation of the VertexArrayGL class methods for managing OpenGL vertex array objects within the ANGLE project, including state synchronization, buffer management, and attribute setup.

classes.name: VertexArrayGL
classes.description: Class managing OpenGL vertex array objects, handling state synchronization, attribute setup, and buffer management within ANGLE.

methods.name: VertexArrayGL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the vertex array object with state, functions, and state manager.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the vertex array and associated buffers, resets state.

methods.name: syncClientSideData
methods.description: Synchronizes client-side vertex data for drawing.

methods.name: updateElementArrayBufferBinding
methods.description: Binds the element array buffer if changed.

methods.name: syncDrawState
methods.description: Prepares the vertex array state for drawing, including streaming attributes.

methods.name: syncIndexData
methods.description: Handles streaming or binding of index data buffers.

methods.name: computeStreamingAttributeSizes
methods.description: Calculates size requirements for streaming vertex attributes.

methods.name: streamAttributes
methods.description: Streams vertex attribute data into buffers for drawing.

methods.name: getVertexArrayID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the vertex array object.

methods.name: getAppliedElementArrayBufferID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the currently applied element array buffer.

methods.name: updateAttribEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables vertex attribute arrays based on current state.

methods.name: updateAttribPointer
methods.description: Sets the vertex attribute pointer for a given attribute index.

methods.name: supportVertexAttribBinding
methods.description: Checks if the platform supports vertex attribute binding.

methods.name: updateAttribFormat
methods.description: Updates the vertex attribute format.

methods.name: updateAttribBinding
methods.description: Updates the vertex attribute binding index.

methods.name: updateBindingBuffer
methods.description: Binds the buffer to a vertex binding point.

methods.name: updateBindingDivisor
methods.description: Updates the divisor for instanced rendering.

methods.name: syncDirtyAttrib
methods.description: Synchronizes dirty attribute states.

methods.name: syncDirtyBinding
methods.description: Synchronizes dirty binding states.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the entire vertex array state based on dirty bits.

methods.name: applyNumViewsToDivisor
methods.description: Adjusts the divisor based on the number of views.

methods.name: applyActiveAttribLocationsMask
methods.description: Applies mask to active attribute locations.

methods.name: validateState
methods.description: Validates the current state of the vertex array object for correctness.
